auto.text:
Morgan reviews Project Atlas on Tuesday at 14:30.
The staging preview validates every imported row.
Production data must remain unchanged during the demonstration.
Avery prepares the checklist before the morning review.
Casey confirms the approved CSV column mappings.
Jordan tests the preview with a small sample.
The draft records all validation errors clearly.
Taylor checks that no production writes are possible.
The team keeps the original file for comparison.
A dry run happens only in the staging environment.
The afternoon review covers accessibility and keyboard controls.
Morgan receives a short summary after the review.
